parameters.query:
WITH input AS (
  SELECT
    NULLIF($1::text, '') AS execution_id,
    left($2::text, 80) AS error_code,
    left($3::text, 500) AS error_message
),
owned AS (
  SELECT run.id, run.status
  FROM public.tender_analysis_runs AS run
  CROSS JOIN input
  WHERE input.execution_id IS NOT NULL
    AND run.source = 'manual_upload'
    AND run.tender_meta -> 'source_payload' ->> 'n8n_execution_id' = input.execution_id
),
ownership AS (
  SELECT
    count(*) AS owner_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('created', 'processing', 'ready_for_aggregation', 'aggregating')) AS eligible_count,
    (array_agg(id ORDER BY id) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('created', 'processing', 'ready_for_aggregation', 'aggregating')))[1] AS eligible_id
  FROM owned
),
updated AS (
  UPDATE public.tender_analysis_runs AS run
  SET status = 'failed',
      error_message = input.error_message,
      updated_at = now()
  FROM input
  CROSS JOIN ownership
  WHERE ownership.owner_count = 1
    AND ownership.eligible_count = 1
    AND run.id = ownership.eligible_id
    AND run.source = 'manual_upload'
    AND run.tender_meta -> 'source_payload' ->> 'n8n_execution_id' = input.execution_id
    AND run.status IN ('created', 'processing', 'ready_for_aggregation', 'aggregating')
  RETURNING run.id
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN input.execution_id IS NULL THEN 'invalid_identity'
    WHEN ownership.owner_count > 1 THEN 'ownership_ambiguous'
    WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM updated) THEN 'manual_run_failed'
    WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM owned WHERE status IN ('completed', 'failed', 'superseded')) THEN 'terminal_no_op'
    ELSE 'ownership_lost'
  END AS outcome,
  (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM updated) AS update_count,
  (SELECT id FROM updated LIMIT 1) AS analysis_run_id,
  input.execution_id,
  input.error_code
FROM input
CROSS JOIN ownership;
